'''Jean-Luc Fugit''' ({{IPA|fr|ʒɑ̃lyk fyʒit}}; born 27 November 1969) is a French politician who has represented the [[Rhône's 11th constituency|11th constituency]] of the [[Rhône (department)|Rhône]] [[Departments of France|department]] in the [[National Assembly (France)|National Assembly]] since [[2017 French legislative election|2017]].<ref name="Bio">{{Cite web|url=http://elections.interieur.gouv.fr/legislatives-2017/069/06911.html |title=Elections législatives 2017 |accessdate=19 June 2017 |work=Ministry of the Interior |language=French}}</ref> A member of [[Renaissance (French political party)|Renaissance]] (RE, formerly La République En Marche!), he was reelected in [[2022 French legislative election|2022]] and [[2024 French legislative election|2024]].

Prior to his election to the National Assembly, Fugit was a vice president at [[Jean Monnet University]] in [[Saint-Étienne]] from 2011 to 2017, which he joined as a chemistry [[research fellow]] in 1996. He was also a [[Municipal council (France)|municipal councillor]] of [[La Grand-Croix]], [[Loire (department)|Loire]] from 2008 to 2013, where he was active for the [[Socialist Party (France)|Socialist Party]] (PS).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.liberation.fr/apps/2017/07/galaxie-macron-assemblee/ |title=La galaxie Macron sur les bancs de l'Assemblée |accessdate= |work=[[Libération]] |language=French |quote=Ancien militant socialiste, Jean-Luc Fugit a été conseiller municipal dans la Loire de 2008 à 2013.}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.20minutes.fr/lyon/2073831-20170523-legislatives-georges-fenech-difficulte-face-fn-rhone |title=Législatives: Georges Fenech en difficulté face au FN dans le Rhône |accessdate= |work=[[20 minutes (France)|20 minutes]] |date=2017-05-23 |author=Vincent Vantighem |language=French |quote=Autrefois conseiller municipal PS à La Grand’Croix (Loire), Jean-Luc Fugit a été séduit par la démarche d’Emmanuel Macron.}}</ref> He has characterised himself as a [[Social democracy|social democrat]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.lyoncapitale.fr/politique/jean-luc-fugit-lrem-je-suis-un-social-democrate |title=Jean-Luc Fugit (LREM) : “Je suis un social-démocrate” |accessdate= |work=Lyon Capitale |date=2017-06-13 |author=Romane Guigue |language=French |quote=}}</ref>
